cat > /workspace/submission/NOTES.md <<'EOF'
# Offline QUIC receive / canonical-wire pipeline

Entry point: `offline.Main` (unchanged format adapter) -> one fresh
`offline.ReceiveAudit` per trace.

## Codec repairs (`de.rub.nds.tlsattacker.core.quic`)

* `layer/data/Parser`: added `parseByteArrayFieldChecked(long)` so 62-bit length
  fields are validated against the remaining input before allocating (a claimed
  length beyond the packet is a truncated encoding), and fixed the off-by-one in
  `parseArrayOrTillEnd`.
* `parser/frame/QuicFrameParser`: frame type is no longer narrowed to `byte`.
* Width narrowing removed everywhere: `StreamFrame`, `ResetStreamFrame`,
  `StopSendingFrame`, `MaxDataFrame`, `MaxStreamDataFrame`, `MaxStreamsFrame`,
  `DataBlockedFrame`, `StreamDataBlockedFrame`, `StreamsBlockedFrame`,
  `RetireConnectionIdFrame`, `DatagramFrame` now hold `ModifiableLong` fields and
  their parsers keep the full varint value (`NewConnectionIdFrame.connectionIdLength`
  stays an int: it is a one-byte field).
* ACK pair handling: `AckFrame` retains every gap/range pair (`getAckRanges`),
  `AckFrameParser` parses exactly `ack range count` pairs (the old loop dropped
  them and mis-counted), `AckFrameSerializer` re-emits them.
* Optional-field serialization: `StreamFrameSerializer` decides OFF/LEN from the
  frame-type bits instead of nullable DTO fields, so lengthless and offsetless
  STREAM frames stay lengthless/offsetless on canonical re-encoding.
* Length-prefixed reads (CRYPTO, STREAM, DATAGRAM, NEW_TOKEN, CONNECTION_CLOSE
  reason) use the bounds-checked parse.

## New offline pipeline (`offline`)

* `ReceiveAudit`: envelope framing (long/short), BAD_HEADER handling, packet
  number reconstruction, the CLOSED/DROP_CID/NO_KEY/PN_RANGE/AUTH/DUPLICATE/
  epoch/frame priority chain, application key epochs, the frame audit for every
  supported type, packet transactions with commit/rollback, canonical envelope
  production and the full result document.
* `Canonical`: minimal varints, PN reconstruction/width narrowing and the
  canonical cleartext header (spin cleared, phase and CID/token bytes preserved,
  long packet length recomputed).
* `ByteStore`: sparse stream/CRYPTO byte ledger with equal-overlap acceptance and
  journalled mutations.
* `RangeSet`: merged disjoint half-open interval union used for ACK sets and for
  the retired-local-CID sequence output.
* `AuditException`, `Undo`: error code + original payload offset, and the
  rollback primitive for the packet transaction.
EOF
